_comment_purpose: Sample itemized medical bill fixture for testing the bill-audit pipeline. Includes intentional duplicates and unknown codes so audit tests can verify detection logic.
_comment_structure: Top-level: patient_id, provider_name, bill_date, items[], total. Each item has: description, code (CPT/HCPCS), category, qty, unit_price, line_total.
_comment_categories: Categories based on realistic CPT groupings: E/M (Evaluation & Management), Lab, Imaging, Procedures.
_comment_duplicates: Items at indexes 2 and 5 are INTENTIONAL DUPLICATES (same code 99214) — the audit should flag these.
_comment_unknown_code: Item at index 6 uses code 'XXXXX' — an invalid/unknown CPT code the audit should flag.
_comment_integration: Load this fixture in tests via: json.load(open('tests/fixtures/bills/sample_itemized_bill.json')). Insert into the 'bills' MongoDB collection with parsed_data set to this object.
